headline: A 2013 law names the Coast Guard's headquarters building in Washington, D.C., after Douglas A. Munro, a Coast Guard hero.
what_it_does: The law gives an official name to the Coast Guard headquarters building on the campus at 2701 Martin Luther King Jr. Avenue SE in Washington, D.C. The building will be called the "Douglas A. Munro Coast Guard Headquarters Building." The law does not create new rules, money, or services for anyone.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on August 9, 2013.
